notes: Only the Agreement is written. ex:stewardshipDuty keeps both of its RL2 roles: it is an odrl:obligation of the Agreement (RL2's independent clause) and the odrl:duty of ex:acceptedAccess (rl2:prerequisiteDuty). It is one duty with one status, so the precondition finding and the reported obligation status always agree. The Researcher bears it in both roles. The Offer's ex:offeredAccess, conditioned on the Promise's status, has no counterpart: a duty's status is not an operand in due2. Scenario 2 shows the standing divergence for an unfulfilled precondition (README). Scenario 3 is added.

expected.why: ex:acceptedAccess applies. ex:ev1 is a witness for ex:stewardshipDuty (actor ex:Researcher, action, object, before effective_at), so the precondition is T and the candidate ready. The permission matches, so the same duty is in force as an obligation and fulfilled (RL2: Fulfilled).

ex:acceptedAccess applies; its duty has no witness, so it is outstanding and, with no deadline, never violated. The only alternative is pending. As an obligation in force the duty is likewise outstanding.
